basic_profile.bio: A dedicated Pokémon Go enthusiast hailing from Cincinnati, Ohio. When I'm not hunting for rare Pokémon, you can find me exploring local coffee shops or cheering for the Laval Rocket. I work as a software developer focusing on mobile apps, which allows me to enjoy flexible online hours, typically in the evenings after 6 PM. I'm currently single and enjoy spending my free time gaming and participating in local community events.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a degree in computer science and a passion for gaming, I've developed a strong understanding of mobile app development. My expertise comes from both formal education and years of hands-on experience in the tech industry. I'm also an avid Pokémon Go player, constantly learning and sharing strategies with fellow trainers.
